notes: Jumping now gives the wanderer an authored airborne silhouette in ordinary play: the body pushes off, both legs tuck around the apex, and the pose opens again for descent before returning to rest on landing.
The motion follows the real jump's vertical velocity and no longer needs WAR_JUMP_MOTION; the optional walk and run previews remain separately gated.
Still short of the mark: starts, landing anticipation and impact, recovery, directional lean, turn cues, camera response, and blends into the optional grounded gaits remain unauthored.
title: Every jump carries its airborne arc
